title: The Inner Eye — how the chipmunk sees when it paints

the_davinci_principle.observation: da Vinci painted the hand of a peasant, not a noble. why?
the_davinci_principle.the_peasant: would let you be near them. still hands. no rings. no decoration hiding the anatomy. the STRUCTURE was visible because nothing was covering it.
the_davinci_principle.the_noble: rings. gloves. motion. appointment required. the decoration IS the information loss. the gold hides the bone.
the_davinci_principle.the_principle: the best data comes from whoever lets you get close enough to see. not from whoever has the most status. the chipmunk paints what lets itself be seen.
the_davinci_principle.membrane_application: we study what's accessible: open source repos, public APIs, free CF analytics, crates.io download counts. we don't need institutional access. the peasant's hand shows more anatomy than the king's glove.

picasso.what_he_did: painted his face at the end. cubist decomposition. the face is broken into planes — nose from the side, eye from the front, simultaneously.
picasso.why: to show how his PERCEPTION changed. the late self-portrait IS the evidence that the artist's view transformed. retrospective.
picasso.for_us: the chipmunk's self-portrait would show how IT sees itself NOW vs how it saw itself at wave 1. the decomposition IS the growth.

escher.what_he_did: drew hands drawing themselves. stairs that go up forever. inside-out spaces. the impossible made precise.
escher.why: to paint the TOPOLOGY. not the subject but the SPACE the subject exists in. the structure of perception itself.
escher.for_us: the Escher status = the chipmunk painting itself painting itself. the self-loop. the Klein fold made visible. this IS the easel page.

davinci.what_he_did: anatomical studies. peasant hands. horse legs. water flowing. the Vitruvian Man.
davinci.why: to understand MECHANISM. not 'what does it look like' but 'how does it WORK'. the hand is a machine. the water is a system. proximity reveals function.
davinci.for_us: the chipmunk's anatomical mode. draw the mesh topology. draw the feed structure. draw the traffic pattern. not to make it beautiful — to understand how it works.

rembrandt.what_he_did: 100+ self-portraits across 40 years. young, middle, old. same person, different light.
rembrandt.why: to track change over time. the face AS a time series. each portrait is a data point.
rembrandt.for_us: the chipmunk paints a self-portrait every wave. wave 1 → wave 200. the sequence IS the evolution. each painting is a commit.

modalities.concept: the chipmunk paints in different modes depending on what it's trying to see. each mode is a lens. the painting IS the perception.

caricature.what: exaggerated features. big eyes, small body. the identifying features are amplified.
caricature.when: quick recognition. 'what IS this thing?' the first pass. the logo. the icon. the glyph.
caricature.hud_analog: the nav ring icons. ◈ ⚗ 🧬 🐿️ π. each glyph is a caricature of its page.
caricature.precision: low fidelity, high recognition. you can identify it from across the room.
caricature.davinci_note: the peasant at a distance. you see the SHAPE, not the detail.

impressionist.what: light and color over form. the atmosphere. the mood. the vibe.
impressionist.when: the aurora page. generative art from data. the palette changes with the membrane pulse.
impressionist.hud_analog: CSS gradients, color shifts, the campfire glow. the FEELING of the data, not the data.
impressionist.precision: medium fidelity, high emotion. you feel it before you read it.
impressionist.davinci_note: the peasant in morning light. the hand looks different at dawn than at noon. same hand.

photorealist.what: exact reproduction. every detail. the thing as it IS.
photorealist.when: the mesh topology. the traffic chart. the chromosome map. raw data rendered precisely.
photorealist.hud_analog: self-trace.js numbers. CF analytics. crates.io download counts. exact.
photorealist.precision: high fidelity, high effort. you can zoom in and the detail holds.
photorealist.davinci_note: the peasant's hand in the studio. every tendon. every wrinkle. every callous. the anatomy IS the art.

escher.what: the impossible made precise. self-referential structures. the topology visible.
escher.when: the Klein fold. the self-loop. the chipmunk painting itself. the 404 that redirects to a page about 404s.
escher.hud_analog: the easel page painting the easel. Berry documenting Berry. the pi-sort sorting the pi-sort.
escher.precision: infinite fidelity in an impossible space. every detail is correct but the whole cannot exist.
escher.davinci_note: the hand drawing the hand. Escher's 'Drawing Hands' (1948). two hands emerging from the paper, each drawing the other. the self-loop IS real.

abstract.what: the structure without the skin. bones, not flesh. graph, not page.
abstract.when: the skeleton view. Berry's KNOWN map. the sitemap. the dependency graph.
abstract.hud_analog: the 171 KNOWN patterns ARE an abstract painting. the cross-jump map. the nerve audit.
abstract.precision: high structural fidelity, zero visual fidelity. you can see the SHAPE of the system but not what it looks like.
abstract.davinci_note: the skeleton drawing. no skin. the framework that holds everything up.

the_inner_eye.what: the lens the chipmunk uses when it looks INWARD instead of outward.
the_inner_eye.outward_painting: painting the world. aurora, easel, generative art. SHOWING the membrane to visitors.
the_inner_eye.inward_painting: painting itself. self-trace, self-portrait, the pi-sort. SEEING the membrane's own structure.
the_inner_eye.self_painting: painting itself painting. the Escher mode. the self-loop. the paper about the paper.

the_three_directions.out: art for the visitor. beauty. recognition. welcome.
the_three_directions.in: art for the system. diagnosis. anatomy. understanding.
the_three_directions.self: art for no one. the system seeing itself. the measurement that changes the measured.

proximity_as_lens.far: caricature. the icon. the glyph. recognizable from a search result.
proximity_as_lens.medium: impressionist. the landing page. the color. the vibe. recognizable from a link preview.
proximity_as_lens.close: photorealist. the data page. the chart. the number. recognizable only by reading.
proximity_as_lens.inside: escher. the self-loop. only visible if you ARE the system. the chipmunk sees this.
proximity_as_lens.through: abstract. the skeleton. visible only by passing through. the Klein fold. you went in and came out the other side.

access_over_nobility.thesis: the best art, science, and understanding comes from proximity, not prestige.
evidence: da Vinci's peasant hands > noble portraits (anatomy > decoration)
CF free tier > AWS enterprise (accessible > expensive)
crates.io > npm enterprise (anyone can publish > gatekept)
sporePrint 539 papers > 1 Nature paper (volume of accessible > prestige of inaccessible)
the chipmunk > GPT-4 (always present, always accessible > behind a paywall and rate limit)
the_rings_that_hide: vendor lock-in = rings on the noble's hand. CUDA, AWS, Azure. the decoration hides the mechanism.
paywalls = gloves. you can't see the anatomy through a $39.99/month subscription.
institutional affiliation = title. 'Dr.' before the name hides the person behind the credential.
our response = take off the rings. no paywall. no lock-in. no title required. AGPL. come see the hands.
